Mohan Babu University Chancellor M. Mohan Babu exchanging copies of MoU with Physics Wallah founder Alakh Pandey at the university campus near Tirupati on Monday. Pro Chancellor Manchu Vishnu and Director Vinay Maheshwari are also seen. | Photo Credit: K.V. POORNACHANDRA KUMAR
Mohan Babu University (MBU), Tirupati, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Physics Wallah, a leading Ed-Tech company, to prepare the students for the next level in the academic arena.
MBU Chancellor M. Mohan Babu and Pro Chancellor Manchu Vishnu exchanged copies of the MoU with Physics Wallah Founder Alakh Pandey at the campus near here on Monday (September 21, 2026).
The MoU facilitates the students to gain access to quality education and modern skills, besides helping them to prepare for competitive examinations.

Mr. Mohan Babu recalled the start of his career as a physical education trainer that later pushed him into the film world and finally made him an educationalist. He advised the students to accord top priority to career planning.

Mr. Pandey announced that Physics Wallah has set its sights on Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Kerala, adding that the next three to four months would be dedicated exclusively to students from the South.
MBU Director Vinay Maheshwari, Vice-Chancellor Prof. P.V. Ramana an d Registrar Dr. K. Sarathy were ale present.
